exclusions: replacement or numerical changes to GeneralizIT

facet.runtime: UNSUPPORTED: mandatory brms/posterior dependencies conflict with exclusions; do not install or copy source

lme4.interface: separate Rscript process; no GPL source copied

theory: Shavelson & Webb (1991), Generalizability Theory: A Primer, Sage
Haberman (2008), When Can Subscores Have Value?, Journal of Educational and Behavioral Statistics 33, 204-229 (PRMSE requires independent definition audit)

reml.method: Gaussian lme4::lmer REML, intercept fixed, all facets random; REML != ML != ANOVA MoM
reml.validation: missing cells/unbalanced allowed only if covariance-component kernels remain linearly independent after intercept projection; no duplicated cells, missing scores, reused nested IDs, singleton facets or unsupported fixed effects
reml.numerical_identification: normalized kernel Gram positive definite with condition <=1e10; at most 10000 observations, 100 levels/facet
reml.optimizer: bobyqa, maxfun=100000, lme4 documented convergence checks; no retries
reml.inference: nonconvergence/singular fit/invalid Hessian preserve diagnostics but suppress G/Phi/D/uncertainty; boundary estimates shown with warning
reml.g_d: p universe variance; relative error = sum components containing p other than p divided by non-p facet counts; absolute error = all non-p-universe components similarly divided; residual aliases highest interaction. For unbalanced observations coefficients describe a NEW balanced target D design, not reliability of unequal observed means.
reml.profile: optional deterministic lme4 profile VC intervals only; square SD endpoints, never call SEM a parameter CI; fail closed on mapping or profiling failure

multivariate.method: balanced complete p x one random facet, 2-5 fully aligned dimensions, matrix method-of-moments using cross-product mean squares (not separate univariate REML fits)
multivariate.covariance: U=(MS_person-MS_residual)/J; F=(MS_facet-MS_residual)/N; E=MS_residual; preserve raw matrices; reject coefficient calculation if any component not PSD within numerical roundoff; no projection/clipping/regularization
multivariate.g_d: relative error E/n_f; absolute error (F+E)/n_f; same facets and event cohort for all dimensions; composite quadratic forms w' V w
multivariate.weights: finite sum-one weights, equal default; negative weights only explicit; unconstrained generalized eigenproblem when total covariance PD; nonnegative SLSQP may only claim LOCAL solution
multivariate.deferred: unbalanced/multivariate REML, mixed/nested multivariate designs, PRMSE/VAR until published definition resolved independently; never label facet's PRMSE formulas as independent validation

advanced.phi_cut: squared-loss criterion-referenced dependability: [U+(mu-cut)^2]/[U+(mu-cut)^2+absolute_error]; not classification accuracy or standard Phi
advanced.d_search: bounded Cartesian counts 2..100; <=10000 candidates; no model refits; explicit per-event and per-facet setup costs; target G/Phi, cheapest feasible and nondominated frontier only inside search bounds
advanced.unsupported: arbitrary fixed facets/custom universe/error sets/aggregation and unsupported CI return explicit Turkish errors, never silently converted

fixtures.source: existing validation/generalizability/balanced.csv unchanged plus new deterministic orthogonal crossed pxixr construction (no RNG); remove prespecified observation indices [0,7,18] for missing-cell case; nest IDs by original parent identifiers; multivariate same event IDs with two deterministic nonproportional scores

tolerances.analytic: rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-10*max(1,reference variance scale), dimensionless coefficients atol=1e-10
tolerances.adapter_vs_direct_lme4: rtol=1e-8, atol=1e-8*max(1,reference variance scale), coefficient atol=1e-8; same objective/options and transformed data
tolerances.reml_vs_mom: compare only balanced interior solutions, rtol=2e-4, atol=2e-4*max(1,reference variance scale), chosen for finite optimizer precision; boundary/unbalanced differences descriptive, never equate objectives
tolerances.psd: eigenvalue >= -1e-10*max(abs(matrix)), symmetry within 1e-12 relative; no substantive negative component accepted
tolerances.affine_reml: variance rtol=2e-4; coefficient atol=2e-4 (same optimizer on standardized data)

statuses: NUMERICALLY VALIDATED fixture/output only after actual independent execution; LIBRARY TESTED for working engine APIs; EXPERIMENTAL for unsupported generalization/local weight optimization; NOT CERTIFIED missing evidence; UNSUPPORTED unavailable/invalid design. No blanket CERTIFIED.
execution: targeted tests, native R in CI if local unavailable, one final full regression in CI; no MC and no new unrelated calibrations. Logs/artifacts even on failure.
